description: Source-preserving Markdown highlight spans. Fixtures live in ClioTests/Fixtures/Markdown/Conformance (never copied). Each vector selects spans of one semantic kind and role from the named fixture and asserts the exact source slices. Derived from ClioTests/MarkdownConformanceTests.swift and the Swift presentation lexer. include: every slice must appear at least once; exclude: no slice may equal any of these; atLeast: slice -> minimum occurrences; exactly: slice -> exact occurrences. Kinds use the Swift MarkdownSemanticKind raw names, roles use the Swift MarkdownSpanRole case names. The macOS suite does not read this file yet; see PARITY.md.
invariants: every span lies inside [0, source UTF-16 length]
span application never changes the source text

vectors.name: delimiters: intraword underscore is not emphasis
malformed-unicode: strong content keeps nested underscore text
